title: Interior Operations Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Interior Operations Manager** to manage and streamline the complete operational process of interior projects—from project handover and procurement to production, installation, quality control, and final handover.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **modular interiors, residential interiors, vendor management, project coordination, team handling, and client communication**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Project Operations**

* Manage multiple interior projects simultaneously from operational handover to completion.
* Coordinate between Sales, Design, Procurement, Production, Site, and Installation teams.
* Ensure projects are executed according to approved designs, BOQs, timelines, and quality standards.
* Track project progress and resolve operational bottlenecks.

**2\. Team Management**

* Manage Interior Project Managers, Site Supervisors, Designers, Installation Teams, and other operational staff.
* Allocate manpower according to project requirements.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and ensure team productivity.
* Establish clear responsibilities and reporting systems.

**3\. Procurement \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with the purchase and procurement team for timely material availability.
* Manage vendors, contractors, carpenters, installers, and other service partners.
* Negotiate with vendors where required and maintain cost and quality standards.
* Ensure materials reach the site as per project schedules.

**4\. Site \& Installation Management**

* Monitor site execution and installation activities.
* Ensure work is completed according to approved drawings and specifications.
* Coordinate civil, electrical, plumbing, false ceiling, modular furniture, and other interior activities.
* Ensure proper site discipline, safety, cleanliness, and material management.

**5\. Quality Control**

* Establish and maintain project quality standards.
* Conduct regular quality inspections.
* Identify defects, delays, and execution issues and ensure timely corrective action.
* Ensure final work matches approved designs and client requirements.

**6\. Timeline \& Delivery Management**

* Prepare and monitor project execution schedules.
* Track critical milestones from production to installation and handover.
* Identify potential delays and take corrective action.
* Ensure projects are completed within committed timelines.

**7\. Cost \& Operational Control**

* Monitor project\-related operational costs.
* Reduce material wastage, rework, labour inefficiencies, and unnecessary expenses.
* Coordinate with accounts and management regarding project budgets and payments.
* Maintain operational MIS and project performance reports.

**8\. Client Coordination**

* Support the Project Manager in handling important client concerns.
* Participate in escalation meetings when required.
* Ensure proper communication regarding project progress, delays, changes, and handover.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction throughout project execution.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On\-time project completion
* Project execution efficiency
* Installation productivity
* Material availability and wastage control
* Vendor performance
* Quality and rework percentage
* Project cost control
* Customer satisfaction
* Team productivity
* Number of unresolved operational escalations

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree/Diploma in Interior Design, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* **5–8 years of relevant experience** in interior operations/project execution.
* Strong knowledge of **modular kitchens, wardrobes, TV units, furniture, false ceilings, electrical, civil and interior finishing work**.
* Strong team\-management and leadership skills.
* Excellent vendor and contractor management skills.
* Good understanding of BOQ, estimation, drawings, production, and installation processes.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.
* Good communication and client\-handling skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, project management tools, and basic reporting.

**Preferred Candidate**

Candidates with experience in **large\-scale residential interior companies, modular interior companies, design\-and\-build firms, or construction companies** will be preferred.

**Reports To:** Head of Operations / Director / Business Head

**Job Type :** Full\-Time \| On\-Site

**Ideal Candidate:** A result\-oriented operations professional who can take ownership of the complete interior execution ecosystem, build accountable teams, control operational costs, and ensure projects are delivered with **quality, efficiency, and timely completion**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

title: City Operations Manager (Fleet)
description:
**Job Summary**

Own end\-to\-end performance of the assigned city: fleet deployment, utilization, uptime, rider operations, customer SLAs, collections, operating cost, people, vendors, compliance and asset protection. The manager converts city targets into disciplined daily execution and timely corrective action.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare and deliver city launch, ramp\-up and weekly deployment plans by client, hub, rider segment and vehicle availability.
* Run daily fleet control: vehicle allocation, rider attendance, shift readiness, idle\-asset action, returns, recoveries and exception escalation.
* Maintain fleet uptime through preventive maintenance planning, breakdown prioritization, technician productivity, OEM coordination and parts availability.
* Onboard riders and field partners with complete KYC, agreements, deposits/authorizations where applicable, vehicle handover records, training and safety briefing.
* Own B2B client operating rhythm, service\-level reviews, issue resolution and accurate deployment/billing inputs; protect partner relationships without weakening asset controls.
* Track revenue drivers, rentals, collections, overdue cases, waivers, city operating cost and unit economics; obtain approval before commercial exceptions.
* Protect vehicles, batteries, chargers, GPS devices and documents through daily visibility, geofence/exception monitoring, incident reporting, recovery and insurance/police processes.
* Recruit, roster, coach and review the city team; set daily priorities, conduct huddles, enforce SOPs and address attendance or performance gaps promptly.
* Manage workshops, towing, parking/yard, charging/swapping and other local vendors against price, quality, safety and turnaround SLAs.
* Publish accurate daily, weekly and monthly dashboards; identify root causes, assign owners and close corrective actions by due date.Ensure compliance with company SOPs, contracts, applicable transport/local requirements, safety standards, data privacy and audit controls.

**Required Skills**

* Graduate or relevant Diploma; MBA/PG qualification in Operations, Supply Chain or Business is preferred but not mandatory.
* 3\-6 years in fleet, last\-mile delivery, mobility, logistics, vehicle rental, field service or hub operations, including at least 1 year of team handling.
* Evidence of managing daily operational KPIs, customer escalations, vendor SLAs, collections/costs and distributed field teams.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets and dashboard ability; comfortable reconciling vehicle\-level, rider\-level and financial data.
* Clear communication in Hindi or English and the local language; valid driving licence and willingness to travel extensively within the city.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

**Key ResponsibilitiesProduction Planning \& Execution**

* Plan and manage **daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules** based on project deadlines.
* Verify **cutting lists, production drawings, and Bills of Quantities (BOQ)** before manufacturing begins.
* Optimize **panel cutting layouts** for plywood, MDF, and HDHMR to minimize raw material wastage.
* Oversee the complete factory workflow, from **cutting and edge banding to CNC machining, assembly, finishing, packing, and dispatch**.
* Identify factory bottlenecks, production issues, or drawing errors at an early stage and take **quick corrective action**.
* Ensure production activities are completed according to approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and project timelines.

**Manpower \& Team Management**

* Allocate daily tasks to **machine operators, carpenters, supervisors, and helpers**.
* Monitor worker attendance, productivity, performance, and overall **shop\-floor discipline**.
* Train, guide, and mentor production staff to improve **workmanship, productivity, and operational efficiency**.

**Material \& Quality Control**

* Coordinate with **Purchase and Stores teams** to ensure the timely availability of boards, laminates, hardware, fittings, and other required materials.
* Conduct strict **quality checks at different stages of production** to minimize defects, rework, and material wastage.
* Ensure proper maintenance and safe operation of heavy factory machinery, including **panel saws, edge banders, and CNC routers**.
* Ensure production areas, machinery, tools, and processes follow required **safety and operational standards**.
* Maintain **daily production reports** and provide regular updates to management regarding production progress and project status.
* Monitor material consumption and production efficiency to help control manufacturing costs.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 5–6\+ years of relevant experience in **interior fit\-outs, modular furniture, or wood\-section factory production**.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Strong understanding of **panel processing, CNC operations, CAD\-CAM files, and cutting\-list optimization**.
* **Material Expertise:** Hands\-on familiarity with **plywood, MDF, HDHMR, laminates, veneers, and modular hardware fittings**.
* **Production Knowledge:** Good understanding of the complete modular furniture manufacturing process, from **cutting to final packing and dispatch**.
* **Core Competencies:** Strong **leadership, problem\-solving, team management, and cross\-functional coordination skills**.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with **design, purchase, stores, production, and site installation teams**.
* Strong understanding of **production planning, quality control, material management, and factory workflow**.

title: Benefits Operations Administrator
description:
**Designation\-Benefits Operations Administrator (BOA)**

**Key Expectations**

* Process all activities related to client benefit plans with high accuracy and timeliness.
* Consistently meet or exceed client Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Develop a strong understanding of client plan provisions and related documentation.
* Prioritize work effectively to respond to client and participant needs.
* Ensure adherence to predefined procedures, process guidelines, and compliance standards.
* Actively participate in daily huddles and status meetings to ensure smooth operations.

**Required Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and ability to handle transaction\-based processing.
* Good computer operating skills, including MS Office applications.
* Typing speed of minimum **25 WPM with 90% accuracy**.
* Good written and verbal communication skills are important.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross functional teams (CS, Tech, Shared Services).

**Role Description**


The **Benefits Operations Administrator (BOA)** is responsible for processing all activities related to client benefits plans as configured in organizational tools, while consistently meeting and exceeding client SLAs.


The role requires developing a strong understanding of client plan provisions, identifying opportunities for knowledge enhancement, and delivering work to high standards of quality and timeliness. The BOA is expected to prioritize work effectively, respond to client and participant needs in a timely manner, and ensure that all knowledge repositories, SOPs, and supporting documentation are current and accurate.


The incumbent conducts research, resolves, and responds to participant issues and inquiries using the case management tool, and collaborates closely with Customer Service, Technology, and other shared services teams for timely issue resolution.


Adherence to predefined procedures and process guidelines is critical to ensure performance parameters are consistently met or exceeded against SLA targets.


Soft Skills:

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
* Ability to multitask under tight timelines
* High level of accountability and ownership
* Customer‑centric mindset
* Adaptability to changing client requirements
